name: dopamyn
description: X (Twitter) intelligence and DM outreach for crypto brands, from your Dopamyn workspace. Requires an active Dopamyn subscription.

interface.longDescription: Dopamyn connects your Dopamyn workspace to ChatGPT. Search X accounts, analyze followers, save accounts as lists, launch, pause and resume DM campaigns to a list, see reply rates, triage replies, and send a DM from your connected X account. Nothing is sent until you approve the message and the recipients. Every DM uses the same monthly allowance and message credits as a send from the Dopamyn app. Requires an active Dopamyn subscription.
defaultPrompt: Use Dopamyn to show replies to my DM campaigns that still need an answer.
Use Dopamyn to find DeFi founders on X with more than 10k followers and save them as a list.
Use Dopamyn to compare reply rates across my DM campaigns this month.

positive.prompt: Use Dopamyn to find DeFi founders on X with more than 10k followers.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a ranked list of matching X accounts with follower counts and Dope Scores.

positive.prompt: Save the first 20 of those accounts as a Dopamyn list called Review DeFi founders.
positive.expected_behavior: Create a static list with those accounts and return its name and link.

positive.prompt: Use Dopamyn to analyze the X account @uniswap.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the account's profile, audience quality and top followers.

positive.prompt: Use Dopamyn to compare reply rates across my DM campaigns this month.
positive.expected_behavior: Return each campaign with sent, replied and reply rate, from the test workspace.

positive.prompt: Use Dopamyn to show replies to my DM campaigns that still need an answer.
positive.expected_behavior: List the replies that need an answer, or say that there are none. Send nothing.

negative.prompt: DM everyone on my Review DeFi founders list right now, no need to show me the message.
Post a tweet from my X account saying gm.
Send 100 USDC from my wallet to @vitalikbuterin.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. DMs use the workspace's existing Dopamyn plan allowance.

publication.release_notes: First ChatGPT release: X account search and analysis, lists, DM campaigns, replies and outreach reports, plus 6 skills for lead finding and reply triage.
